note: Bavli: [Menachot 32b:10](sefaria:Menachot.32b.10) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “the household of King Munbaz”. Royal house (Adiabene); same 'של בית X היו ...' formula as בית דושאי in fn 124. Also Niddah 17a:15.
Bavli: [Shabbat 144b:1](sefaria:Shabbat.144b.1) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “the house of Menashya bar Menaḥem”. Same 'של בית X היו ...' formula; also 144b:3.
Bavli: [Berakhot 43a:15](sefaria:Berakhot.43a.15) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “the house of Caesar”. Paired with בית רבי (fn 125): 'אפרסמון של בית רבי ... של בית קיסר'.

Bavli: [Bava_Metzia 49b:4](sefaria:Bava_Metzia.49b.4) (4 segments). Gazetteer: “the house of Parzak, the general”. Persian official's household. Paper has only the toponym מפרזקיא (fn 348). Also Avodah Zarah 61b:13.
Bavli: [Yevamot 97b:9](sefaria:Yevamot.97b.9) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “the sons of Yudan the maidservant”. בני X of a freed slave woman (matronymic).

item: משפחת יוחנן / משפחת רבן יוחנן (from משפחה אחת היתה בירושלים)
note: Bavli: [Rosh_Hashanah 18a:9](sefaria:Rosh_Hashanah.18a.9) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “a certain family in Jerusalem”. Family renamed after Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai: 'והיו קורין אותה משפחת רבן יוחנן על שמו'; also 'ממשפחת עלי'. Parallel Yevamot 105a:15.
Bavli: [Avodah_Zarah 9a:5](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.9a.5) (11 segments). Gazetteer: “The school of Eliyahu”. Example of the דבי X item; not cited in the paper.
Bavli: [Arakhin 19b:6](sefaria:Arakhin.19b.6) (17 segments). Gazetteer: “the school of Menashe”. Example of the דבי X item; not cited in the paper.
Bavli: [Bava_Kamma 10b:18](sefaria:Bava_Kamma.10b.18) (27 segments). Gazetteer: “the school of Ḥizkiyya”. Example of the דבי X item; not cited in the paper.
Bavli: [Bava_Batra 52b:10](sefaria:Bava_Batra.52b.10) (8 segments). Gazetteer: “the school of Levi”. Example of the דבי X item; check that each hit is the tannaitic collection.
Bavli: [Bava_Kamma 47b:19](sefaria:Bava_Kamma.47b.19) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “the school of Karna”. Karna is in the paper only as דייני גולה -- קרנא.
